reply_text:
I replied to Tobias in his #central-random thread. I confirmed the correction: the 2026 Marrow Agrisupply renewal is 84 seats. I also told him I keep no separate record, so there was nothing to update. I suggested he fix his original post in #central-team so people there see the right number.

I didn't take any other action, and I didn't read #central-team. A seat count is an operational fact, not a finance figure, so posting it in that channel was allowed.
